name: Seed Junky | 3.5g Prepackaged Flower | Triple P's
description: Triple P' is a beautiful trichome-covered dense indica, that is smooth smoking with all-white ash and relaxing cerebral high that isn't going to put you out. Triple P'z has strong flavors of a sweet yellow cake terpene with a hint of licorice.
